title: pgAssistant - Recommendation Lifecycle
description: Evolution, persistence, appearance and resolution of stable Executive Plan findings.

list.name: team
list.label: Team
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT team AS __value, team AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND team IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(environment,'unknown') AS __value, coalesce(environment,'unknown') AS __text FROM pga_collection_run ORDER BY 1

list.name: target_id
list.label: Target
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target_id AS __value, coalesce(target_name,target_id) AS __text FROM pga_collection_run WHERE coalesce(environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 2

list.name: priority
list.label: Priority
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT priority AS __value, priority AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot WHERE priority IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: finding
list.label: Finding
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ON (finding_fingerprint) finding_fingerprint AS __value, left(title,90) || ' [' || left(finding_fingerprint,8) || ']' AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND team IN (${team:sqlstring}) ORDER BY finding_fingerprint,collected_at DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('${bucket:raw}',x.collected_at) AS time,x.team AS metric,count(DISTINCT (x.target_id,x.finding_fingerprint)) AS findings FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=x.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(x.collected_at) AND x.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND x.finding_fingerprint IN (${finding:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT x.team,x.advisor_id,x.title,count(DISTINCT x.target_id) AS targets,count(DISTINCT x.run_id) AS snapshots,min(x.collected_at) AS first_seen,max(x.collected_at) AS last_seen FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=x.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(x.collected_at) AND x.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND x.finding_fingerprint IN (${finding:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) GROUP BY x.team,x.advisor_id,x.title ORDER BY snapshots DESC,targets DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH runs AS (SELECT p.run_id,p.target_id,p.collected_at,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p.target_id ORDER BY p.collected_at DESC) rn FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot p JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=p.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.collected_at) AND p.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})), cur AS (SELECT x.* FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=x.run_id AND r.rn=1 WHERE x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND x.finding_fingerprint IN (${finding:sqlstring})), prev AS (SELECT x.* FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=x.run_id AND r.rn=2 WHERE x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND x.finding_fingerprint IN (${finding:sqlstring})) SELECT coalesce(c.target_id,p.target_id) AS target_id,CASE WHEN p.finding_fingerprint IS NULL THEN 'NEW' WHEN c.finding_fingerprint IS NULL THEN 'RESOLVED' ELSE 'PERSISTING' END AS lifecycle,coalesce(c.team,p.team) AS team,coalesce(c.priority,p.priority) AS priority,coalesce(c.advisor_id,p.advisor_id) AS advisor_id,coalesce(c.title,p.title) AS title,coalesce(c.finding_fingerprint,p.finding_fingerprint) AS finding_fingerprint FROM cur c FULL JOIN prev p ON p.target_id=c.target_id AND p.finding_fingerprint=c.finding_fingerprint ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.finding_fingerprint IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN c.finding_fingerprint IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,target_id,title LIMIT 500;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id,target_id,collected_at FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC), history AS (SELECT target_id,finding_fingerprint,min(collected_at) AS first_seen,count(DISTINCT run_id) AS snapshots FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) GROUP BY target_id,finding_fingerprint) SELECT l.target_id,x.team,x.priority,x.advisor_id,x.title,h.first_seen,l.collected_at AS last_seen,h.snapshots,x.scope_name FROM latest l JOIN pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x USING(run_id) JOIN history h ON h.target_id=x.target_id AND h.finding_fingerprint=x.finding_fingerprint WHERE x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND x.finding_fingerprint IN (${finding:sqlstring}) ORDER BY h.first_seen,x.target_id LIMIT 100;
